More variety. More color. More scrappy fun.

If you love the charm of a perfectly mismatched quilt, the Scrappy 2½" Strip Club is calling your name! Each month, you’ll receive a 42-piece curated bundle of assorted 2½" strips designed to give you that beautifully scrappy look — without having to cut a thing.

Every shipment features a fresh mix of prints and colors, blending designer fabrics, playful motifs, and stash-building essentials. From bright and bold to soft and subtle, these strips are made to mix, mingle, and make your quilts shine.

Perfect for:
• Jelly roll patterns
• Log cabin blocks
• String quilts
• Borders, bindings & accent strips
• Building a versatile, ever-growing stash

The beauty of scrappy sewing is in the surprise — and each month brings a new combination to spark your creativity.

✨ A different mix every month
✨ Limited duplicates within each bundle
✨ Ready-to-sew convenience

Join the Scrappy 2½" Strip Club and start stitching something wonderfully scrappy!

When you join the Scrappy 2½" Strip Club, your credit card is charged $29.99 monthly (12 times per year).

Shipping in the U.S. is $3.99* per month; Canadian shipping is $6.99* and international shipping is $8.99* per shipment. (*excluding first shipment - regular shipping charges apply to your first order)

Remember KQ Gold members pay no shipping on any subscription over $35!
